partnershipPlan: Two patient partners review the interview guide and the joint display; one of them stopped the video programme after two weeks.
socialListening: No social media listening; the service's feedback forms from the video groups are read for comments on technology and group size.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: It was the first time in years I could do a class without asking my son to drive me an hour each way.
items.implication: Report travel saved as part of the experience findings.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I spent the first session trying to find the sound and nobody could hear me.
items.implication: Add a technology check call before the first session.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My mother understood the exercises when I translated, but she would not ask questions in front of the group.
items.implication: Offer interpreters and a one-to-one check-in during the programme.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: On a small screen I cannot always see if the knee is collapsing inward.
items.implication: Ask participants to position the camera side-on for key exercises.

summary: Four composite voices on travel, technology, language and observation.
